content: {"paper_id":"W2119046205","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"The CPSL can effectively integrate the discriminative information of labeled log images, the geometrical information of labeled log images and the weakly similar information of unlabeled images together to learn a reliable subspace.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方法同时利用有标注日志图像的判别/几何信息与无标注图像的弱相似信息学习子空间，属于有限监督结合未标注样本的半监督设定。"},{"keyword_id":"dimensionality-reduction","exact_quote":"In this paper, we propose a novel subspace learning framework, i.e., Conjunctive Patches Subspace Learning (CPSL) with side information, for learning an effective semantic subspace by exploiting the user historical feedback log data for a CIR task.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"明确提出子空间学习框架并学习语义子空间，属于显式低维嵌入/维度约简表示。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","reason_zh":"摘要出现weakly similar information和成对约束，但未明确以不完整/不精确的实例级真值替代完整监督并作为核心设定，弱监督界定不确定。"},{"keyword_id":"pairwise-constraint-propagation","reason_zh":"仅提到利用相似/不相似成对约束，未说明对must-link/cannot-link关系进行传播或扩展，机制证据不足。"}],"input_issues":[]}
